extracted.intended_audience: senior emergency management personnel expected to perform in management roles during Area Command or Multi-Agency Coordination Systems
extracted.subtask_description: Course description and logistics for the I-400 ICS for Complex Incidents advanced training course, including learning objectives, prerequisites, target audience, length, cost, and registration instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course Length
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total instructional duration for the I-400 course.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target Audience
rubrics_metrics.description: The target audience for this course is senior personnel who are expected to perform in a management capacity in an Area Command or Multi-Agency Coordination Systems are established.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course is designed for senior/management-level personnel; not intended for entry-level responders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course Objective — Explain management challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain how major incidents engender special management challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learners should be able to articulate unique management issues posed by major or complex incidents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course Objective — Area Command circumstances
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the circumstances in which an Area Command is established.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learners should identify triggers, thresholds, and situational factors that warrant establishing an Area Command.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course Objective — Multi-Agency Coordination Systems circumstances
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the circumstances in which Multi-Agency Coordination Systems are established.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learners should explain when and why MACS are stood up and what problems they address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course Objective — Apply NIMS doctrine
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply key NIMS doctrine concepts to the management of a complex incident or event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical application of National Incident Management System principles to real-world complex incidents is expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course Objective — Identify coordination issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify the complex incident management issues that can result from a lack of multiagency coordination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learners should be able to diagnose coordination failures and their operational impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course Objective — Apply structural options
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply the appropriate structural option to manage a complex Incident.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learners should select and justify organizational/command structures appropriate to a given complex-incident scenario.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prerequisites (must be most recent version)
rubrics_metrics.description: IS-100.c: Introduction to the Incident Command System; IS-200.c: Basic Incident Command System for Initial Response; IS-700.b: National Incident Management System, An Introduction; IS-800.d: National Response Framework, An Introduction; ICS-300 (E/I/L/G): Intermediate Incident Command System for Expanding Incidents (Course must have been taken after April 2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All listed courses are required before taking ICS-400; ICS-300 must have been completed after April 2019. "Must be most recent version" implies participants should have up-to-date certificates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost / Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no fee for the course. Other cost considerations are detailed in each LMS course offering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While tuition is free, participants should check the LMS listing for other potential costs (materials, travel, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Signup / Registration Instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Register through the New York State DHSES Learning Management System. Access the LMS through the link on the calendar webpage. Office of Emergency Management—Training and Exercises Section at (518) 292-2351 or OEM.Training@dhses.ny.gov
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the registration channel (NY SDHES LMS) and contact phone/email for questions or administrative assistance.
